input.subject: Oven not heating – Flat 2, 176 Lantern Quay (ref R/PM025-1)
input.body:
Hello,

Thank you for reporting the oven fault at Flat 2, 176 Lantern Quay, Westmarsh, ZZ8 5ZZ (ref R/PM025-1). The landlord has replied and would like the oven looked at under its warranty by the contractor who fitted it last year. We are tracing that contractor's details now and will be in touch once someone is ready to arrange a visit.

To help with the warranty claim, could you please reply with the oven's make and model (usually on a label inside the door frame or on the side of the door), plus a photo of that label if possible?

In the meantime, please don't attempt to open or repair the oven yourself.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team
